name: Butrint
description: Butrint is an ancient city in southern Albania, about 14 kilometres south of Sarandë and close to the Greek border. It sits on a wooded hill above the Vivari Channel, and its ruins include Greek, Roman, Byzantine and Venetian remains. Settled since prehistoric times, it was abandoned in the Middle Ages once marshes spread across the area, and today you can wander its remains inside a national park.
